title: THE SEVENTY-FOUR DOLLAR MAN
deck: A $74 FAAB bid for Tutu Atwell. A competing bid of $5. A Sunday verdict still to come.
author: Frank ‘The Hammer’ Haggerty
body: One manager. One receiver. Seventy-four dollars. And a decision made under circumstances involving beer, shots and a bowling alley.
A $74 FAAB bid for Tutu Atwell has raised serious questions inside the Sleeping Giant Fantasy Football League. The next-highest bid? Five dollars, courtesy of The Right Hook.
The Chafe Mob manager submitted the winning offer during bowling league festivities. That is a detail this newsroom intends to revisit when the full evidence is in.
The manager has also pledged CAD $74 for a Sunday football feast. Whether that meal becomes a victory banquet or the most expensive consolation dinner in league history remains to be seen.
“Seventy-four fucking dollars. For one waiver claim. I’ve seen more restraint at an all-you-can-eat buffet. But I’ll wait for the evidence before I hang the bastard.” — Frank “The Hammer” Haggerty
THE INVESTIGATION REMAINS OPEN. No verdict has been reached. The full story will follow the relevant games and verified results.
